head_south.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. One isolated FRONT/south head sprite for a small RimWorld pawn.
Image 1 is the OLDER v5 head and primary edit target: good recognizable face/eyes/nose/mouth, but its lower jaw is a little too long and pointed.
Image 2 is the LATEST v6 head: it went TOO FAR into a broad round U-shaped face and deleted the nose / reduced the mouth to a rectangular dash. Do NOT copy that roundness or missing features.
Make a restrained middle version between these two. The user explicitly wants LESS ROUND than v6 and CLEAR NOSE AND MOUTH.
FACE GEOMETRY: Start from image 1's face. Shorten its lower face only modestly, about 8-10 percent, roughly halfway toward the shortening in image 2. Preserve gentle tapering cheek-to-jaw slopes and a small distinct chin, but soften the very tip. The final face is a softly tapered oval / short soft V, NOT a round disk, broad bowl, flat-bottomed U, baby cheeks, or the old long sharp V. Lower-cheek width should sit between the two inputs. Chin height should be visibly BETWEEN their chin heights. Keep the head/hat/hair overall size and position, and keep the eye line near image 1.
FACIAL FEATURES MUST REMAIN VISIBLE: Restore a clearly legible SMALL NOSE in the central face: a tiny warm grey-brown angled tick/wedge, approximately 1.5-2 native pixels tall at final 256px scale; no large white shine or three-dimensional nose shading. Restore a NATURAL SMALL MOUTH, similar to image 1, about 3-4 native pixels wide: a shallow slightly shaped neutral lip line with a modest darker center and at most a tiny subdued lower-lip accent. Do not omit the nose, fade it into the skin, erase the mouth, or replace lips with a fat black rectangular UI dash. Leave a sensible short spacing between nose, mouth and chin. Both marks need to survive native-size viewing.
EYES: keep image 1's calm, slightly narrow half-lidded grey-green eyes and recognizable expression, with a distinct simple darker pupil and at most one small highlight. Simplify excessive tiny iris facets and duplicate eyelid wrinkles. Do not use image 2's blank flat rectangular toy eyes, do not enlarge into baby eyes. One restrained brow per eye, sparse marks, broad mostly flat skin.
Line style: robust near-black outer cheek/jaw contour comparable to the existing hair and local RimWorld sprites, around 2.5-3 native pixels; thinner readable facial marks. Low-detail 2D small-game-sprite finish, not a polished portrait, not a featureless symbol, no fine textures or glossy lighting.
IDENTITY LOCK: retain image 1's ash-silver grey-green hair, long front lock at IMAGE LEFT, one low coiled bun also at IMAGE LEFT behind it, opposite small curved wisp, plum hat and blue-grey bow/two dark-tipped ribbons on IMAGE RIGHT. Do not change hat size/tilt, head rotation, hair arrangement or colors. Entire upright FRONT HEAD only, no neck/body. Real transparent alpha with padding, no backdrop/checkerboard/text/panels/shadows.

head_east.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create ONE isolated RIGHT-facing EAST PROFILE head sprite for a small RimWorld pawn, matching the provided Vertin images.
Image 1 is the older v5 EAST head: primary visual source for recognizable facial anatomy, but the lower jaw/chin is too long and somewhat angular.
Image 2 is the latest v6 EAST head: a cautionary example; its face became TOO ROUND and its natural mouth became a thick floating black dash. Do not repeat this.
Image 3 is the newly corrected v7 FRONT head: match this character, her soft tapered oval face and restored small nose/mouth.
Make a restrained INTERMEDIATE profile between images 1 and 2. Start with image 1. Shorten the lower face only modestly (about halfway toward image 2), keep a gently angled cheek-to-chin jawline with a distinct but softly rounded small chin. Chin should visually lie between the two previous chin heights, slightly higher and softer than v5, slightly lower and more tapered than v6. NOT a rounded bowl, ball, flat-bottomed U, baby face or a long jutting angular chin. Keep the eye line / hat / head position close to v5. Head upright, looking right, true side profile, never a tilted or three-quarter head.
FACIAL ANATOMY: retain a small readable bridge and NOSE TIP in the silhouette, with a tiny subdued brown-grey nostril/nose tick just inside it, enough to survive downsampling to a 256px sprite. Restore a natural, small, neutral MOUTH connected to the face profile like image 1, a restrained slightly shaped lip line, about 2-3 native pixels long, with one tiny subdued lip accent if needed. Do NOT erase nose or lips, fade them away, or use a floating fat black UI dash. The profile should have a subtle nose-lips-chin sequence, without excessive sharp zigzags. Flat skin, no three-dimensional nose highlight or portrait shading.
Eye/expression: calm half-lidded slightly narrow grey-green eye like image 1/3, simplified pupil and at most one restrained highlight; one eyebrow and sparse thin internal lines, do not make the giant blank toy eye of image 2. Keep the ear small/simple like image 2; remove the long dangling exposed skin below the v5 ear and instead keep a clean short hair edge. No neck.
Robust near-black outer jaw/head outline of roughly 2.5-3 native pixels, subtler facial lines. Matte low-detail 2D game texture, broad restrained color shapes, no glossy skin, no intricate iris texture, no extra decorations.
IDENTITY LOCK: same ash-silver grey-green swept hair and front lock at image RIGHT, small single low bun partly hidden at rear IMAGE LEFT; preserve plum tilted hat shape, blue-grey bow on image LEFT and exactly two dark-tipped ribbons. Do not invent a second bun, change colors, or rotate the head. Entire isolated head only with real transparent background and generous padding. No body, neck, text, panels, shadows or checkerboard.

note: Prompt percentages are visual guidance, not measured final anatomical ratios; deterministic formatting settings are in recipe.json.
